verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents Git Sync for managing workspace resources programmatically, and the company describes this as "git version control". That gives a first-party basis for versioning automations, and the docs separately mention approvals, which loosely supports review. However, the evidence never describes what Git Sync covers (syncs, journeys, audiences), how review of changes works, or any rollback or restore mechanism. Missing for 10: documented scope of versioned resources, a change-review workflow tied to versions, an explicit rollback/revert capability, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.
